name: Kaiki Gensou Yume Monogatari Kaijuu Kidan Izayoi Jigoku
original_name: 怪奇幻想夢物語 怪獣綺譚 誘宵地獄
source: Yukari has tried this last forbidden technique twice so far. The first time to revive a beloved cat, and the second time to revive a beloved sister who died in an accident. Yukari never imagined that it would eventually lead to a number of tragedies ...
translation: 到目前为止，由香里已经尝试过两次这最后的禁忌技巧了。第一次是为了救活心爱的猫，第二次是为了救活因事故去世的心爱的妹妹。由香里万万没有想到，这最终导致了一系列的悲剧……
